Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill, take two pills and call me in the morning 💊."

JACK: 
"No, I won't do it. I don't need your pills. I'm fine, really 🙅‍♂️."

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, you're not fine. You're delusional. You need to take your medication to stabilize your mind 💥."

JACK: 
"I don't need your help. I can take care of myself. And I don't need your pills to prove it 💪."

DR. SMITH: 
"Fine, take them yourself then. I'll show you they're safe 💊."

Jack looks at Dr. Smith with a mischievous grin, and Dr. Smith, feeling a sense of unease, reluctantly hands Jack the pills 🤔.

DR. SMITH: 
"Here, take them. I'll just... uh... go get some papers to sign 📝."

As Dr. Smith walks away, Jack takes the pills and swallows them down with a sly smile 😏.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith returns to Jack's room, but Jack is nowhere to be found 🤔. Dr. Smith looks around, confused, and that's when he sees it - a figure standing in the corner of the room, looking exactly like him 👻.

DR. SMITH: 
"Who are you? What are you doing here? 🤯"

The figure, also Dr. Smith, looks back at him with a calm, collected expression 😌.

DR. SMITH (IMAGINARY): 
"I'm you, Dr. Smith. And I've been here all along, trapped in this asylum, living out a delusional reality 🤪."

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as the truth hits him - he's the one who's been schizophrenic the whole time 🤯.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
